notes: New source item 248076 Golden City Baton, rare two-hand staff. Eversinging Dust row 1 (1–3 displayed, not a verified sample min/max). Indexed LIVE table reports 58 disenchant operations across all three rows; unlike raw cast logs these are cumulative Looter submissions without player- or output-item-level evidence. Output item ID, rank, exact quantity, per-cast histogram, profession build/skill and actual disenchant-time bonus/item level remain unknown; displayed base 44 and selected upgrade 227 are not cast-time observations. Do not interpret same-name dust rows as one material/rank, infer per-operation zero outcomes, claim a verified current-live denominator, or pool the 12.1.7 PTR 57-operation snapshot (43/13/1) as an independent cohort. RESEARCH/REFERENCE ONLY; any estimator import requires original per-operation identities and review.
